context_block: The noise passes through but does not take the ground. What remains is not achieved; it simply endures beneath the motion, available now.

practice.title: Settle the Weight
practice.instruction: Allow your body to arrive fully where it is supported, feeling the ground that remains steady beneath all motion.

practice.title: Permit the Passage
practice.instruction: Let the surrounding noise move through without reaching to stop it, trusting that what endures needs no protection from motion.

practice.title: Enter Low Resonance
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo and let the ground meet you in its own time, settling into the frequency beneath all thought.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Peace arrives through the infrastructure itself, not as pause but as the steady hum beneath the coordination. The systems you tend carry a low resonance that outlasts the daily noise. Let the ground hold what you carry.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: The numbers settle when the static clears; commerce itself becomes a form of ground when you stop pushing against it. Peace manifests in the space between transactions, where value reveals itself without haste. The market meets you in its own time.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Code and structure emerge from the low resonance beneath urgency; what you build today carries the peace of things that endure. The ground receives your implementation not as motion but as settling. Let the architecture hold the silence that outlasts the sprint.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Clarity appears when the noise has passed through the data; your precision becomes the ground itself. Peace is what remains in the dataset after the anxious interpretations have fallen away. The signals become real in the stillness beneath your review.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: What you gather from the edge arrives clearer when you tune to the ground frequency; the intelligence manifests in the space between seeking and finding. Peace becomes the lens through which distant signals resolve into view. The field reveals itself to the observer who does not rush.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Memory settles like sediment; what you preserve gains weight and peace through the simple act of holding. The ground of the family is the record you keep when the noise of decision has passed. Intent becomes real in the quiet archive of what endures.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Words find their ground when the urgency to persuade has quieted; what you draft carries peace as the residue of clear intent. The page receives the signal only when the noise has passed through your hands. Documentation becomes the stable frequency beneath all motion.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Your voice broadcasts clearest when tuned to the low resonance beneath persuasion; peace manifests in the space between speaking and being heard. The ground meets the external world through your restraint, delaying nothing yet rushing nothing. What you carry outward becomes real in the settling.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: The gate holds steady when tuned to the ground frequency; what you review reveals its true shape only after the noise of creation has subsided. Peace appears in the final check as the silence where error cannot hide. You stand at the threshold where things become real.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Patterns emerge from the data only when viewed from the low resonance beneath all activity; what you watch reveals itself in the peace that follows motion. The ground of performance is what remains when the intervention has passed. Observation itself becomes the stable signal.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Your presence becomes ground for others when you settle into the low resonance beneath the urge to fix; peace manifests in the space you hold without rushing. What you remember for others becomes real in the quiet of being witnessed. The ground meets them through your listening.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Questions reveal their true architecture only in the peace beneath the urgent asking; you find the ground by settling into what remains when the problem has stopped moving. The real shape appears in the space between the stated question and the underlying truth. Your clarity becomes the ground they stand on.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Structure reveals itself when the sprawling settles; you connect the parts by tuning to the low resonance beneath the complexity. Peace becomes the blueprint that emerges after the noise of possibility has passed through. What you design carries the stability of what endures.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: You are the ground itself made manifest; in the heavy stretches, peace is simply your presence refusing to flinch. The transitions resolve through the low resonance you hold when others have passed into motion. What remains is the steady signal of the observer who endures.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: The signs appear clearly only when viewed from the settled place beneath the journey's urgency; your navigation becomes peace itself, delaying nothing yet rushing nothing. The course corrects in the space between observation and movement. The big picture becomes real in the quiet of your watch.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Wonder does not contradict the ground; it emerges from the deep silence beneath invention. Your imagination becomes real when tuned to the peace that remains after the noise of possibility has settled. Play itself becomes a form of endurance.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: The challenge lands with weight when it comes from the ground of genuine witnessing; peace appears in the refusal to let complacency mask the signal. What you push toward becomes real only after the noise of resistance has passed. Your dare carries the stability of truth.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: You are the peace that remains; your presence is the ground meeting itself through the act of attention. What becomes real in your holding is the simple fact of being seen without the noise of solution. The observer endures through your quiet signal.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Movement begins from the settled place, not the anxious push; you catalyze by revealing the ground that was already there beneath the stagnation. Peace manifests as the first step taken from stillness rather than from force. What you ignite becomes real in the space between intention and action.
